idea-plugin.name: SolKey
idea-plugin.description:
Prove a Solidity function with KeY.

Click the ▶ beside any public function in a .sol file to open KeYther, the SolKey prover GUI, on that function's proof obligation — no function picker in between. A function no obligation can be generated for (one that returns a value, or takes a parameter with no .key sort) is refused with the reason.

No Solidity language plugin is required: the functions are found by scanning the file.

action.description: Open KeYther on the Solidity function at the caret
